hotel_description: "Vista Rooms at Arpora JunctionAboutRich in culture, architecture, food, and most importantly, beaches, Goa is one place no travel-lover can miss out on. The spacious and beautifully designed rooms of the hotel have a lot to offer from comfort, to luxury, to everything essential. Listing all the attractions of Goa is nearly an impossible task to do because of the vast number. Considered by many visitors to be the most beautiful part of the state, Goas stretch of southern coast running from Betul down to largely forgotten Polem in the very south, is a beach-lovers dream of golden sands, gentle surf, and the mellowest vibe imaginable. Famous throughout the Roman Catholic world, the imposing Basilica of Bom Jesus, situated in Goa, contains the tomb and mortal remains of St Francis Xavier, the so-called Apostle of the Indies. Mainland Indias original dive operator, with 25 years experience, Goa Diving is an internationally respected outfit and a good place to earn your PADI certificate. Facilities

How to Reach
To reach the hotel you can hire a taxi from the airport and any of the stations. To commute in the city you can either book a local taxi or hire an auto. 

Rooms

If you are travelling with a group of friends or with family then you can even request for interconnected rooms. The room also comes with attached bathroom equipped with geyser and running water.

The building has parking facilities, lobby, power back up, first aid kit, fire extinguisher, dining area and a bar. Guests also have access to the swimming pool and the garden outdoor. International guests are welcomed to stay with us.

hotel_description: LocationLooking for a comfortable yet an affordable stay in Hyderabad? OYO Premium Himayath Nagar could be your option, which is located at a distance of 350 m from Tirumala Tirupati Devasthanam Temple. The hotel is situated 33.4 Km away from Rajiv Gandhi International Airport and 3.9 Km from Nampally Railway Station as well as from Nampally Metro Station, this hotel is suited for both business as well as leisure travelers. While the nearest bus stop is Liberty Road Bus Stop (450 m) away. During your stay here, you could explore nearby tourists destinations like Lumbini Park (2.8 Km), Birla Mandir & Planetorium (2.7 Km) and Snow World (3 Km). The famous markets like Brand Factory (600 m), Jagadish Market (3 Km) and Mozamjahi Market can also be a part of your visit. Apollo Emergency Center (1.8 Km), Mediciti Hospital (2.2 Km) and win Hospital (3.3 km) are nearby, in case of medical emergency. How to ReachWhile hiring a taxi/auto-rickshaw from anywhere in the city to the hotel is a convenient option, you could also use the well-connected local city buses to commute locally. Other than that, there is Hyderabad Metro which can be used until Nampally Metro Station followed by a taxi/auto-rickshaw to get to the hotel. RoomsSpacious and air-conditioned rooms that are fully furnished with the most comfortable beds and clean linen would definitely impress the traveler in you. Also, there is a banquet hall and a conference hall where you can arrange small gathering. We also welcome expats to stay with us.

hotel_description: The impressive Fort & Garh of Tordi is situated in a cosy village, tucked away in one of the ranges of Aravalli hills; this range covers an area of 30 kms and abounds in natural beauty. address: Sardar Patel Marg, C- Scheme,
hotel_description: Rajmahal Palace is one of the oldest and most treasured properties in the Pink City of Jaipur. Belonging to the Royal Family of Jaipur, this exquisite private palatial home is set in the prime location in the center of Rajasthans bustling capital.Initially comprising of 13 Royal Apartments, Suites and Palace Rooms.DiningThe CollonadeAs the original Verandah of Rajmahal Palace, The Collonade is the perfect place to meet for a coffee, enjoy a light lunch or catch up with friends over an informal dinner and cocktails. In clement weather, guests can sit on the lawns and enjoy the views of the Palace Gardens.The Collonade is open 24 hours a day for resident guests and for lunch and dinner to non residents.51 Shades of Pink Adil Ahmad drew influence for this dining room from an iconic Vogue Cover photographed by Norman Parkinson in 1952. The shades of pink have been inspired by the Sharbata courtyard inside The City Palace, Jaipur.Breakfast for resident guests only. Lunch for both residents and non residents.The Orient OccidentStep into this grand dining room of Rajmahal Palace and experience a rich heritage of the rulers Rajputana. With its high ceilings, gilded mirrors and original artworks, an evening spent here is one that will be remembered forever. The carefully crafted menu offers authentic Indian recipes and the finest of European cuisine.The Polo BarOriginally the library, and now aptly named The Polo Bar, this calm space allows guests to enjoy a drink surrounded by the original silver polo trophies of The Maharaja of Jaipur and old team photographs. This is the perfect place to unwind after a day spent exploring the city.Enjoy signature Martinis, Manhattans and classic cocktails. Sample from a grand collection of fine premium international spirits, single malts, cognacs, and pair them with a fine cigar from our extensive menu.Afternoon TeaAfternoon Tea is an essential ritual at Rajmahal Palace. A choice of champagne, and a discerning selection of the finest Indian teas, combined with a delicious menu makes for an unforgettable afternoon.Private DiningFor those wishing to celebrate a special occasion or to simply enjoy some time alone there are few better ways than indulging in an exclusive evening within one of the residential private dining rooms or in a unique location in the Palace Grounds.One of the special privileges of staying at Rajmahal Palace is having access to dine in an exclusive and private location at The City Palace - presently the official residence of the The Royal Family of Jaipur. The Palace Chef will personally meet with you to create your perfect culinary experience. Rajmahal Palace is the ultimate venue for celebrating in style!Organic GardenThe Rajmahal Palace Organic Kitchen Garden has been carefully planted to provide delicious fresh herbs, vegetables, and salads for our kitchens. Our gardeners delight in walking you around to explain the qualities of each, and help you pick your basket for a healthy, green lunch should you wish to. In case you require any assistance regarding food, in terms of preferences, allergies, or dietary requirements, please feel free to call for the chef at any time.SpaA sense of well-being is at the heart of Rajmahal Palace, the beautiful art deco swimming pool with views over the gardens is the perfect spot to indulge and relax.The SUJN Spa, presently located in Rang Niwas offers a carefully selected menu of therapies that can revitalise and relax you mind and body.

hotel_description: Perched on a rocky incline, Hotel Rawalkot Jaisalmer is a heritage haveli, made of golden sandstone, close to the medieval town. Hotel Jaisalmer is located close to the business district amidst historic havelis, picture perfect sand dunes and colour-changing stone walls. The hotel architecture exudes a medieval charm and serves as the perfect vantage point to watch the Jaisalmer Fort change color from sunrise to sunset. It is well-equipped with all the modern comforts and amenities along with a highly efficient and intuitive staff that's at your service 24x7. Hotel Rawalkot is a charming hotel built along the lines of a traditional Rajasthani Haveli (house). It is situated on a ridge which offers commanding views of the city and Jaisalmer Fort. At Hotel Rawalkot, we're committed to offering you an authentic Rajasthani experience with contemporary efficiency. So, while the hotel architecture exudes an old world charm, you'll find that the rooms are smart with tastefully appointed interiors and equipped with the best amenities in the city. However, it is our 24x7 quick and hassle-free service that truly delights our guests. Hotel Rawalkot seems to rise out of the rocks. Inspired by the grand havelis of yesteryear, Hotel Rawalkot presents postcard-perfect sights of the Jaisalmer Fort built in 12th century apart from the setting sun. The design of the hotel makes use of a wide range of local colors, materials as well as fabrics.You can also have a ball on the Jeep and Camel Safaris organized by the hotel. To give you a feel of the local culture and heritage, Rawalkot also arranges cultural programs like folk dances and music. In case a request is made, this hotel would gladly arrange tents closer to sand dunes as well.The hotel is 2KMS or 15MINS from the railway station also accessible by road via Jodhpur 300KMS or 6HRS by road.The hotel has 42 guest rooms split between modern rooms and deluxe tents (Operational from October to March). The hotel also features large terraces and a swimming pool overlooking the city.
